notes.title: Get ready for a new adventure!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359629/ea055ed998d9a3c3eb0f3232e46d6a218b4f9570.png[/img]

Mariya, a girl with Russian roots. When you look at her you can tell that she's a real party girl and enjoys a life without any problems, but that's not true at all..... After numerous complaints and expulsions from school for hooliganism, her father takes her to his homeland in Japan. And it seemed all is well, another country, another school, but once she learns about the tournament "Call of Senpai", but that would get there need to gain the necessary number of points from the curators who have their "cockroaches" in his head, which falls on Mariya.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359629/6c71035053228727ffe729abc4a0da438f1910ca.png[/img]

- Perform a variety of interesting missions to advance in the story.
- Explore the open world, which has become 20 times more, you have access to the beach, mountains, hotels and a couple of cities, everywhere there are various additional activities.
- All need money! The money you receive on missions, we can spend it all on clothes, or save it for weapons or vehicles. Remember, each of your failures on missions penalizes you. 
- You have access to improved customization of your character, bored with the hair? Go to the hairdresser's. Tired of the costume? Run home or to the nearest clothing store and change!
